Simplified Description: Contact → SOW → Payment → Design → Development → SEO/Analytics → Maintenance.
Detailed Description: Initial Client Contact → SOW Signed → Payment Completed → Design (Weeks 1–4) → Development (Weeks 4–8) → SEO/Analytics (Weeks 8–12) → Marketing & Maintenance (Months 4–6).

Simplified Description: Sales identifies and pitches tailored plans to potential clients.
Detailed Description: The Sales Department identifies potential clients and conducts outreach. Initial client meetings focus on understanding the client's business needs and pitching a tailored service plan.

Simplified Description: Client Success drafts the SOW, which starts upon signing and payment.
Detailed Description: After verbal agreement on the proposed services, the Client Success Team drafts a Statement of Work (SOW) that outlines project details, deliverables, timelines, and costs. Once the SOW is signed by the client and payment is received, the project officially begins.

Simplified Description: Admin and Client Success share client details and goals with the team.
Detailed Description: The Admin Department and Client Success Team communicate the client's details, goals, and approved SOW to the internal teams.

Simplified Description: Design creates wireframes in Figma and delivers 10–20 pages by Day 30.
Detailed Description: The Design Team begins creating wireframes and initial designs in Figma, focusing on core branding, services, and client goals. Every 14 days, a Sprint Review is conducted where designs are presented to the client for feedback or approval. By Day 30: The Design Team delivers 10–20 pages, including additional landing pages if required.

Simplified Description: Development builds and optimizes the site, completing by Day 60.
Detailed Description: The Development Team begins building the approved designs, starting with key components like the header, footer, homepage, and core pages. Tasks include WordPress setup, page development, performance optimization, and analytics integration. By Day 60: The development team completes the website and prepares for QA testing.

Simplified Description: SEO and Analytics ensure tracking, reports, and alignment by Day 90.
Detailed Description: The SEO Team implements on-page SEO strategies, keyword research, and AI-driven content creation. The Analytics Team QA tests GA4 events and GTM configurations and builds Looker Studio reports for ongoing tracking. Goals by Day 90: Complete alignment between design, development, SEO, and analytics.

Simplified Description: Ads run on landing pages, with ongoing SEO and Analytics optimization.
Detailed Description: Ads are launched using dedicated landing pages optimized for conversions. The SEO and Analytics teams optimize ad copy, adjust targeting, and monitor campaign performance. They also produce AI-driven content for organic growth and update landing pages as necessary.

Simplified Description: SEO and Analytics track performance, while teams create new assets as needed.
Detailed Description: The SEO Team focuses on backlink building, content updates, and keyword optimizations. The Analytics Team tracks campaign performance using tools like GA4, Google Search Console, and Looker Studio. Design & Development Teams collaborate with SEO and Analytics to create new assets as needed.

Simplified Description: Client Success delivers updates, logs changes, and shares progress reports.
Detailed Description: The Client Success Team manages communication with the client, including monthly updates and feedback collection. Logs all changes in a Change Log for full transparency. Reports include SEO insights, keyword performance, and progress summaries.

Simplified Description: Project Managers ensure all tasks stay on schedule and aligned.
Detailed Description: The Project Management Team oversees all tasks to ensure deadlines are met. Regular internal check-ins are conducted to monitor progress and address roadblocks.

Simplified Description: Progress updates and deliverables shared every 14 days with clients.
Detailed Description: Every 14 days, progress is shared with the client, including deliverables and updates.

Simplified Description: Monthly data-driven performance summaries and action plans.
Detailed Description: Clear, data-driven updates that showcase performance metrics and next steps.

Simplified Description: Comprehensive records of all project adjustments.
Detailed Description: A comprehensive record of all adjustments made to the client’s project.
